title: Sources: Jensen Huang's daughter remains in a senior Nvidia role; before Jensen Huang resigned, she was his de facto chief of staff with considerable authority (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: Sources: Jensen Huang's daughter remains in a senior Nvidia role; before Jensen Huang resigned, she was his de facto chief of staff with considerable authority — Installed as her father's de facto chief of staff, Jensen Huang's daughter alienated top executives.
